description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the loan withdrawal process by an applicant in the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup methods, test cases for applying for a loan and withdrawing it, and helper methods for collateral management.

classes.name: LoanWithdrawnByApplicantIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for testing the process of an applicant withdrawing a loan application in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, sets up request/response specifications, and prepares the helper for loan transactions.

methods.name: loanWithdrawnByApplicant
methods.description: Test case that simulates an applicant applying for a loan and then withdrawing it, verifying the loan status transitions.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Helper method to add collateral information to the collaterals list.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Creates a HashMap representing collateral with specified ID and quantity.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan application with collaterals for a specific client and loan product, returning the loan ID.
